backend: Basic Memory Markdown sync service + project-scoped SQLite FTS5 SearchService
authorization: fixed organization_id and knowledge_space_id mapped to a Basic Memory project_id; reject mismatched request scope; validate source path
limitations: Basic Memory CLI/MCP startup is incompatible with the resolved FastMCP/MCP dependency pair; this implementation uses Basic Memory's supported Python parsing, sync, and search services directly.
Basic Memory does not expose ingestion file/byte/backend-call counters; those setup fields are null.
Search uses Basic Memory FTS5; no embedding or external inference stage is used.
